name: Faerie Realm
description: The realm of stories reached across the Threshold, subject to human creativity and glamour; visitors gain fable points and warping there.

name: Arcadia
description: The face of the Faerie Realm where new stories are born, reached by the Path of Chance; a place of adventure where players share control of the story.

name: Elysium
description: The Land of Legend, a face of the Faerie Realm where all stories already told live on as faerie copies and can be reenacted.

name: Eudokia
description: A face of the Faerie Realm where personal dilemmas and life changes are faced through moral fables along the Forking Path.

name: Path of Chance
description: The rambling road into Arcadia, named because journeys along it have no plan or purpose; most trods lead to it.

name: Path of Destiny
description: The road into Elysium by which a character takes a role in a legendary story to gain a boon; rarely found by accident.

name: Forking Path
description: The path into Eudokia, embarked upon by those entering a Faerie Aura on the verge of a major life change.

name: Mother Road
description: A route that can deposit characters leaving Faerie somewhere other than where they entered.

name: Summerlands
description: Land of Summer where pies grow on trees and rivers run with mead and milk; where one is forever young.

name: Ironwood
description: The traditional abode of the hag, filled with her wolfish children, in the Perilous Forest story element.

name: Maddenhofen woods
description: Woods into which the Founder Tytalus disappeared with no spectators.

name: Asgard
description: Home of the Norse gods, from which Idun was abducted in legend.

name: Palace of Woven Grass
description: Example story element: prison of the child stolen by the Rye-King.

name: Wounded River
description: Random story element, a river of blood where Arduinna bathes and the Stone Drum is hidden in the example story.

name: The Market at the Crossroads
description: Scenery story element: a faerie market of rough stalls where purchases are not always what they seem.

name: The Glass Mountain
description: Scenery story element: a towering mountain of smooth green glass topped by a castle and guarded by giant birds.

name: The Perilous Forest
description: Scenery story element: a dark, foreboding wood hiding outlaws, hermits, magical trees, and beasts.

name: The Forbidden Chamber
description: Scenery story element: a room in a castle everyone is forbidden to enter, testing curiosity against obedience.

name: The Abandoned Shrine
description: Scenery story element: a standing stone carved with glyphs where a slumbering god can be woken by innocent blood.

name: Winter (Story Element)
description: Scenery story element of snow and frost representing sterility and patience, a guardian or prison.

name: Summer (Story Element)
description: Scenery story element of bounty and vigor that lulls one to sloth.

name: The Empty Forest
description: Example Eudokian story element: a forest villain whose trees resent animals.

name: The Ancient Wall
description: Example Eudokian story element doubling as Guardian of the Threshold, which must be climbed properly.

name: Fable Score
description: Measures accumulated vitality spent in Faerie; determines time dilation and warping on leaving and lets characters swap Virtues and Flaws for faerie ones.

name: Fable Points
description: Points gained by taking part in Faerie stories; spent on creativity offers and converted to fable score.

name: Vitality
description: The human life-force that faeries harvest; its expenditure in Faerie is charted by fable score.

name: Glamour
description: The faerie substance spread over areas and faeries; can be altered by creativity and replaces the flesh of those who stay in Faerie.

name: Creativity in the Faerie Realm
description: Mechanism by which a character with unspent fable points makes a creative offer to alter Faerie's environment, symbolism, or a faerie's attitude.

name: Offer Total
description: Roll of Communication + Charm, Profession or Craft plus modifiers, used to make creative offers to change a Faerie story.

name: Promise of Service
description: A promised action accompanying an offer that symbolically transfers vitality to Faerie and negates the story's threat.

name: Threat Level
description: Classification of obstacles (Trivial to Overwhelming) setting the Ease Factor of creativity offers.

name: Warping
description: Permanent effects from Faerie; characters may take Warping points on leaving to reduce time dilation.

name: Twilight
description: Magi need not check for Twilight from Warping points taken when leaving Faerie.

name: Faerie Time Dilation
description: Time passes faster in the mortal world relative to Faerie, based on the final fable score.

name: Guardian of the Threshold
description: The being or barrier met on entering and leaving Faerie; it sends characters home once the story concludes.

name: Threshold
description: The boundary into the Faerie Realm, attracted by conditions such as trods, auras, artistic works and auspicious times.

name: Threshold Faerie
description: A faerie that mediates Eudokian stories governing a life transition and sends characters home with Spirit Away.

name: Trod
description: Faerie trods are by far the most common routes into Faerie and almost all lead to Arcadia.

name: Faerie Aura
description: Supernatural aura associated with Faerie; entering one on the verge of life change leads to the Forked Path.

name: Aura
description: Supernatural aura of a location; the destination aura modifier affects Arcadian Travel.

name: Regio
description: Faerie regiones have their own time dilation effects, distinct from the Faerie Realm.

name: Arcane Connection
description: A link to a destination that reduces the Ease Factor of Arcadian Travel by 6.

name: Might
description: Supernatural power score; a human in Faerie with Increased Might gains a Might pool instead of a score.

name: Penetration
description: Calculated from maximum Might pool for faerie-touched humans; Mjollnir's lightning penetration equals wielder's Might.

name: Magic Resistance
description: Humans gaining Might in Faerie do not gain Magic Resistance.

name: Pretences
description: Abilities granted by faerie Virtues to humans in Faerie are gained as Pretences, not real Abilities.

name: Cognizance
description: A faerie's awareness of its nature; humans made faerie are Narrowly Cognizant, and highly cognizant faeries understand glamour alterations.

name: Faerie Powers
description: Virtue requiring Might pool; biblical figures in Elysium have Faerie Powers rather than Divine Powers.

name: Spirit Away
description: Faerie power used by a Threshold faerie to send characters back to the mortal realm.

name: Personality Traits
description: Traits changed by creativity offers against faeries or adjusted after Eudokian journeys.

name: Confidence
description: Confidence points reward plot devices and are spent to identify as the hero in Elysium.

name: Fatigue
description: Long Term Fatigue Level is spent to make a creative offer; glamoured bodies are immune.

name: Decrepitude
description: Characters with a glamoured faerie body are immune to Decrepitude.

name: Aging
description: Characters in the Faerie Realm make aging rolls based on time spent in Faerie, not real-world time.

name: Gauntlet
description: The end of Hermetic apprenticeship; apprentices about to take it may share a Eudokian story.

name: Plot Device
description: A secret proverb given to a player to influence the plot once in a Faerie Realm adventure.

name: Player-Driven Stories
description: Stories where players decide scenery and characters met while the storyguide controls the plot.

name: Player-Influenced Stories
description: Stories where players alter events affecting their own character using plot devices.

name: Story Elements
description: Actors, props, and scenery linked together to build Faerie stories, one per story experience point.

name: Dramatis Personae
description: Story roles (hero, villain, princess, donor, etc.) that story elements can fill.

name: Donor
description: Story role that provides the heroes with the means to succeed.

name: False Hero
description: Story role of an impostor who seeks to steal the hero's honor.

name: Villainy
description: A story act used as a link between story elements.

name: Trickery
description: A story act used as a link between story elements.

name: Transference
description: Story act transporting characters to another story element.

name: Reconnaissance
description: Story act initiated by encountering the villain.

name: Receipt
description: Story act in which heroes receive aid from a donor.

name: Story Experience
description: Experience points awarded per story; guide the number of story elements.

name: Elysian Quest
description: Reenacting a legend on the Path of Destiny to gain insight or a boon of faerie nature.

name: Identification as the Hero
description: Declaring oneself the legendary hero after the Guardian, costing a Confidence point and granting a fable point.

name: Measure of Success
description: Fable points earned in an Elysian quest determine Failure, Mediocre, Accomplished, or Unmitigated Success.

name: Initiation Script
description: Mystery cult initiation; an Elysian quest can grant a bonus of +1 to +3 to it.

name: Initiation Quest
description: Part of a Mystery initiation which may involve interfering in Elysian legends.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Cults whose initiations may use Elysian quests.

name: Insight
description: Magical process granting knowledge of lost magic; Elysian quests cannot provide it.

name: Faerie Boons
description: Blessings or maledictions gained from Eudokian journeys: Virtues balanced by Charm Flaws, or fading Flaws.

name: Faerie Patron
description: Source of bequeathed Might that grants a bonus to offers under Art & Academe rules.

name: Elysian Guardian
description: Guardian of the Path of Destiny, usually of the kerberos type, conferring a hero symbol with a boon and prohibition.

name: Kerberoi
description: Guardian type taking the form of horrible monsters or dangerous challenges; rare in Eudokia.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The order of magi whose legends are also witnessed in Elysium.

name: House Merinita
description: Hermetic house of faerie magi with Mysteries like Arcadian Travel and Becoming; most travelers in Elysium belong to it.

name: House Flambeau
description: Hermetic house whose tales portray Bonisagus differently.

name: First Tribunal
description: Hermetic legend witnessed by magi in Elysium.

name: Schism War
description: Hermetic conflict ended by the Tempest; its many confused retellings are equally true in Elysium.

name: The Tempest
description: Event that ended the Schism War, witnessed in Elysium.

name: Merinita
description: Founder of House Merinita; Elysian versions give the impression she is alive in Faerie.

name: Bonisagus
description: Hermetic Founder whose meeting with Merinita is witnessed in Elysium; appears differently per house tales.

name: Tytalus
description: Founder whose disappearance into the Maddenhofen woods cannot be illuminated in Faerie.

name: Canaanite Necromancy
description: Long-forgotten tradition of necromancy sought by a magus through an Elysian quest.

name: Grail Quest
description: Arthurian legend not yet fully realized in 1220.

name: Wild Hunt
description: Spectral host evoked by an Elysian Guardian; only a strong wind confronts those who continue.

name: A Thousand and One Nights
description: Islamic story collection told by rawis, suitable for Elysian adventures.

name: Humanoid Faerie
description: Virtue granting a glamoured faerie body; must be taken before Increased Might and requires a Traditional Ward.

name: Increased Might
description: Virtue granting a human in Faerie a Might pool.

name: Warrior
description: Virtue granting experience points; in Faerie gives Abilities as Pretences.

name: Puissant Stealth
description: Virtue exchanged by Coll for Humanoid Faerie.

name: Social Contacts
description: Virtue exchanged by Coll for Reputation as Confidence.

name: Reputation as Confidence
description: Virtue gained by Coll in Faerie.

name: Free Expression
description: Virtue granting +3 to offers made to faeries.

name: Puissant Charm
description: Virtue; bonus not cumulative with Free Expression for offers.

name: Tough
description: Virtue associated with the Courage theme in Eudokia.

name: Cautious Sorcerer
description: Virtue associated with the Magic theme in Eudokia.

name: Puissant Craft
description: Virtue associated with the Skill theme in Eudokia.

name: Arcadian Travel
description: Merinita Mystery Virtue allowing departure from the Faerie Realm before the story ends to a chosen destination.

name: Becoming
description: Merinita Mystery Virtue simulating transformation into a faerie.

name: Lesser Benediction
description: Faerie Virtue by which powers learned from faeries are gained.

name: Traditional Ward
description: Flaw that must be acquired by a character gaining a faerie body.

name: Feud
description: Mundane Flaw swapped out first when becoming faerie.

name: Outlaw Leader
description: Mundane Flaw swapped out first.

name: Mentor
description: Flaw; a mundane Mentor may become a faerie Mentor.

name: Supernatural Nuisance
description: Flaw that may become a faerie one.

name: Disfigured
description: Flaw appropriate to faerie-touched characters.

name: Lesser Malediction
description: Flaw appropriate for faerie-touched characters, e.g. sterility.

name: Branded Criminal
description: Flaw replaced for Coll as inappropriate among faeries.

name: Weakness for Women
description: Flaw exchanged for Disfigured in the Coll example.

name: Lesser Charm
description: Flaw balancing faerie Virtues; a Minor Virtue's governing charm.

name: Noncombatant
description: Flaw that makes a Bravery-themed Eudokian story unfair.

name: Fear
description: Flaw associated with Courage theme.

name: Careless Sorcerer
description: Flaw associated with the Magic theme.

name: Clumsy
description: Flaw associated with the Skill theme.

name: Stealth
description: Ability; Coll failed a Stealth roll against faerie wolves.

name: Charm
description: Ability used to make verbal offers.

name: Profession: Storyteller
description: Ability used to make verbal offers to Faerie.

name: Craft
description: Abilities used by crafters to work offers into objects.

name: Faerie Lore
description: Ability; score 1 grants awareness of time loss and how to guard against it.

name: Faerie Magic
description: Ability; limits additional travelers in Arcadian Travel.

name: Carouse
description: Ability checked when wooing an ice maiden.

name: Athletics
description: Ability rolled to climb the Ancient Wall.

name: Auram
description: Hermetic Form; a magus wielding Mjollnir uses his Auram score for lightning penetration.

name: Mjollnir
description: Thor's hammer, a thunderbolt imprisoned in iron that inflicts +30 lightning damage.

name: The Poisoned Apple
description: Prop: a fruit half poisoned, half sweet, typically shared.

name: The Dragon's Tongue
description: Prop: eating it grants powers like speaking with animals; proof of slaying the dragon.

name: The Swan Cloak
description: Prop: a cloak of white feathers that transforms the wearer into a swan.

name: The Dull Knife
description: Prop: a crude blade that may cut the uncuttable or rust when another is in peril.

name: Snake Soup
description: Prop: a cauldron whose white snake meat grants supernatural strength and resilience.

name: Stone Drum
description: Random story element whose sound ceases all Arduinna's powers.

name: Tree of Silver
description: Story element from which an arrow to kill the Rye-King must be fashioned.

name: The Soul in the Egg
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Magic Ring
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Self-Filling Purse
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Horn that Furnishes Soldiers
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Helm of Invisibility
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Word That Opens All Locks
description: Further idea for a prop story element.

name: The Pied Stranger
description: Actor: a half-white, half-black musician who is a thief and entertainer.

name: Grateful Lions
description: Actor: two playful, speaking lions who offer friendship for aid.

name: The Captive Princess
description: Actor: a maiden imprisoned by her parents, guarded by an ogre, dragon, or thorns.

name: The Task-Setting Ogre
description: Actor: a giant who forces captives to perform impossible tasks.

name: The Mouse-Groom
description: Actor: a talking mouse who courts a female character.

name: The Ferryman
description: Actor: a gray-cloaked ferryman, perhaps a disguised king, who must be persuaded to carry characters.

name: The Pale Man
description: Actor: an emaciated vampire in a shroud, or Death itself.

name: The Cruel Stepmother
description: Further idea for an actor story element.

name: The Queen of Otters
description: Further idea for an actor story element.

name: The Boy Made from Iron
description: Further idea for an actor story element.

name: The Evil Twin
description: Further idea for an actor story element.

name: Queen of Winter
description: Faerie queen whose woods and palace feature in the creativity example.

name: King of Summer
description: Faerie king whose court features in a plot device example.

name: Ice Maiden
description: Local faerie of the Queen of Winter's woods who can thaw the earth.

name: Rye-King
description: Example story element: a faerie king who has stolen a child.

name: Lofanneth Wolf-Brother
description: Faerie captive of Arduinna and donor who knows where the Stone Drum is hidden.

name: Arduinna
description: Faerie villain who holds the Enchanted Priest captive; weakened by the Stone Drum.

name: Enchanted Priest
description: Story element: local priest held by a disgruntled faerie.

name: Red Knight
description: Elysian Guardian in red enamel armor demanding single combat.

name: Kerberos
description: The three-headed dog guarding the Underworld, an original Elysian Guardian.

name: Minotaur
description: Monster of the labyrinth whose place characters could take in Elysium.

name: Sphinx
description: Arcadian Guardian demanding a riddle she cannot answer.

name: Barking Beast
description: Creature of the Arthurian tale hunted by Sir Pellinore.

name: Pan Caudarax
description: Dragon example target of an Elysian quest, with a weak spot in his hide.

name: The Leafy Counselor
description: Eudokian example tree acting as Donor, at odds with its fellows.

name: The Son of the Coin
description: Eudokian example mercenary acting as the False Hero.

name: The Dying Lady
description: Eudokian example ancient ash tree, source of the forest's antagonism.

name: Birthing Faerie
description: Threshold faerie attracted by a pregnant mother.

name: Grave-Faerie
description: Threshold faerie met by an old man.

name: Will-o'-the-Wisp
description: Faerie that may lead characters home from Eudokia.

name: Coll
description: Example grog who gains faerie Virtues in Arcadia.

name: Branoic
description: Example character with Faerie Lore who limits his fable score.

name: Aethelbald
description: Saxon nobleman who spent 140 days in Faerie and returned in 1220.

name: Roland
description: Legendary hero of the Song of Roland fighting the Moors in Spain.

name: Idun
description: Norse goddess abducted from Asgard in legend.

name: Theseus
description: Greek hero of the labyrinth and the Underworld.

name: Merlin
description: Legendary wizard encountered in Elysium.

name: Romulus
description: Legendary founder of Rome, with Remus.

name: Odin
description: Norse god who whispered to his dead son Balder.

name: Balder
description: Son of Odin whose funeral can be witnessed in Elysium.

name: Orpheus
description: Legendary hero whose role a magus takes in an Elysian quest.

name: Eurydice
description: Orpheus's lost lover.

name: Persephone
description: Queen of the Underworld whose heart Orpheus melts.

name: Hades
description: Underworld and its ruler; characters could play Hades.

name: Judges of the Dead
description: Figures of the Underworld negotiated past in the Orpheus story.

name: Thor
description: Norse god whose hammer Mjollnir can be stolen or retrieved.

name: Thrym
description: Giant who stole Thor's hammer.

name: Culhwch
description: Welsh hero cursed until he marries Olwen.

name: Olwen
description: Welsh heroine whose father is cursed to die when she weds.

name: Reynard the Fox
description: Fox protagonist of a Märchen story used in an Elysian quest.

name: Chantecler
description: Cockerel caught by Reynard.

name: Tibalt
description: Cat Reynard races.

name: Tiercelin the Raven
description: Raven whose cheese Reynard seeks.

name: Prince Ivan
description: Hero example used for identification in Elysium.

name: Sir Pellinore
description: Knight of the Barking Beast tale.

name: King Arthur
description: Legendary king whose court's romances are well known in Mythic Europe.

name: Sir Lancelot
description: Arthurian knight yet to appear in familiar form.

name: Gawain
description: Arthurian knight who beheads the Green Knight.

name: Green Knight
description: Knight beheaded by Gawain; also an actor story element idea.

name: Perceval
description: Arthurian romance hero suitable for Elysian stories.

name: Chevalier De Panne
description: Knight who fought Pan Caudarax and lived.

name: Snorri Sturluson
description: Great compiler of Norse myths, alive in Iceland in 1220.

name: Demeter
description: Goddess who ceased her search for her daughter in winter.

name: Hercules
description: Greek hero of the Sorrows and Labors.

name: Prometheus
description: Greek legend figure with Epimetheus and Pandora.

name: Icarus
description: Greek figure of the Flight of Icarus.

name: Cu Chulainn
description: Irish legendary hero.

name: Oisin
description: Irish hero of Oisin and Niamh.

name: Pwyll, Prince of Dyfed
description: Welsh legendary prince.

name: Bard, the God of Snaefell
description: Icelandic legend figure.

name: Huon of Bordeaux
description: Chanson de geste hero.

name: Maugis d'Aigremont
description: Chanson de geste hero.

name: Herzog Ernst
description: German epic hero.

name: Es-Sindibad
description: Sindbad of the Sea and of the Land from A Thousand and One Nights.

name: Prince Camaralzaman
description: Prince of a Thousand and One Nights tale with Princess Badoura.

name: Antar
description: Slave, warrior, and poet of Arabic legend.

name: Rustem
description: Slayer of dragons and demons.

name: Samson
description: Biblical hero, of Samson and Delilah.

name: David
description: Biblical king of David and Goliath.

name: Job
description: Biblical figure of the Testing of Job.

name: Lot
description: Biblical figure who escaped Sodom and Gomorrah.

name: Jael
description: Biblical heroine of Jael and Sisera.

name: Saul
description: Figure of the Conversion of Saul.

name: King Jereboam
description: Biblical king in I Kings 13.
